```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/config.R")
source("R/load.R")
desc <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "descriptive.rds"))
cv <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "course_view.rds"))
res <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "baseline.rds"))
n_small <- desc$n_sites - length(desc$big_sites)
read_table <- function(name) read.csv(file.path(config$tables_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))

num <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  format(round(x, digits), big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",", nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE)
}
# Percentages; signed = TRUE writes +3,2 % or −1,7 % (Unicode minus).
pct <- function(x, digits = 0, signed = FALSE) {
  s <- num(abs(100 * x), digits)
  sign <- ifelse(x < 0, "−", if (signed) "+" else "")
  paste0(sign, s, " %")
}
dec <- function(x, digits = 2) ifelse(x < 0, paste0("−", num(-x, digits)), num(x, digits))
fr_date <- function(d) format(d, "%d/%m/%Y")
fr_month <- function(d) format(d, "%m/%Y")
# Typst only reads files under report/, so each figure is copied from
# outputs/figures to report/_figures (not versioned) before being included.
fig <- function(name) {
  file <- paste0(name, ".png")
  dir.create(file.path("report", "_figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  stopifnot(file.copy(file.path(config$figures_dir, file), file.path("report", "_figures", file),
                      overwrite = TRUE))
  knitr::include_graphics(file.path("_figures", file), error = FALSE)
}
```
